question: Provenance of the initial band / channel / bandwidth / sideband / default chanspec for the BCM4352 ASUS PCE-AC56 board

entry.selection: r14d is the current/validated chanspec; wlc_default_chanspec(wlc->pub, 1) is called at 0x3c5b7 when the current chanspec is invalid or band-mismatched, and again at 0x3c602 as fallback

calls: wlc_phy_chanspec_band_firstch 0x702ee (fallback if next_chanspec returns 0xff and band_lock)
wlc_default_chanspec.semantics: pick the first valid channel for the current band from the regulatory/locale channel set; fallback to the band's first channel from a static channel table

provenance.detail: wlc->band is selected at attach (wlc_attach / wlc_bandlock); band availability derives from SPROM aa2g/aa5g and NVRAM country

wlc_create_chspec -> wlc_channel_locale_flags + wlc_valid_chanspec_db; wlc_next_chanspec iterates the valid set; wlc_phy_chanspec_band_firstch walks a static channel table (relocated global array) using phytype/phyrev and band
band-first builds a 20 MHz chanspec (or 0xD800 form); no 40 MHz sideband by default on the initial default
40 MHz sideband bits are part of the chanspec encoding; not set by the 20 MHz default
wlc_default_chanspec(wlc->band,1) result; not a hardcoded channel
country code (locale) and band-enable flags; no guessed default channel

open: The exact runtime band (2.4 vs 5 GHz) and first channel on this board are not fixed at analysis time; they are COMPUTED_RUNTIME from SPROM/NVRAM/regulatory state. This is causal input to the radio-ON PLL path, not a constant.
